digest: The basis and physiological functions of senescence have been challenging to establish as senescent states encompass varying hallmarks in disease and ageing, and too little is known about which cells undergo senescence in which contexts.

497d6245c1dfe017.title: Incorporation of atmospheric components in planetary magma oceans through bubble-metal compounds.
digest: Atmophile elements (carbon, hydrogen, and nitrogen) were thought to accrete late during planetary formation, yet cosmochemical and astrophysical evidence suggests that they were already present while small bodies, such as Vesta, were forming.
High-temperature magmatic events on small bodies, however, should have outgassed these ultravolatile elements because gravity would have been insufficient to retain them.

digest: Scabies affects ∼400 million people annually, yet current therapies lack ovicidal activity, require repeat dosing, and are increasingly compromised by treatment failure and resistance.
The absence of a single-application therapy capable of eliminating both motile mites and eggs represents one important limitation to effective disease control.
